Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Are you an experienced Java Developer or Squad Lead looking for your next challenge across enterprise cloud, fintech, or digital transformation projects?
 If you enjoy building scalable microservices, migrating architectures to the cloud, or leading Agile squads, this role is for you.
 Our philosophy is “First who, then what.” 
 📍 This role is hybrid with 1-2 days on-site in Bucharest.
 🚀 First who? 
5+ years of software development experience with Java (8, 11, or 17) and Spring Boot.
Solid background in microservices and RESTful APIs.
Hands-on experience with databases (PostgreSQL, SQL) and JPA / Hibernate.
Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or IBM Cloud) and Docker/Kubernetes.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Git, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins) and testing (JUnit, Mockito).
Experience or interest in mentoring peers or stepping into a Squad Lead role.
Fluent in English and comfortable in Agile/Scrum setups.
 🚀 Then what? 
You’ll develop and scale high-volume microservices for cloud and fintech platforms.
You’ll drive cloud migration and modernization initiatives from design to production.
You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, with opportunities to guide architecture or lead a squad.
 📌 Your mission 
Design, build, and maintain enterprise Java applications using Spring Boot
Contribute to cloud migration and microservices architecture projects
Write clean, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews
Support automated CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and production stability
Share knowledge, mentor colleagues, or coordinate squad delivery if acting as a lead
 ⚙️ Your toolbox 
 Technical Skills
Java (8, 11, 17) & Spring Boot
Microservices & REST APIs
PostgreSQL, SQL, and JPA / Hibernate
Cloud (AWS, Azure, or IBM Cloud) & Containers (Docker, K8s, OpenShift)
CI/CD (Git, Jenkins, Maven/Gradle) & Testing (JUnit, Mockito)
Kafka, Angular, or Terraform / Helm - plus
 General Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
High sense of ownership and quality focus
Great communication and collaboration in Agile environments
Fluent command of English
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the First who and see yourself thriving in the Then what ?
 👉 Apply now and let’s talk.
